title: A Quiet Place to Kill
writer: Marcello Coscia, Rafael Romero Marchent, Bruno Di Geronimo
actors: Carroll Baker, Jean Sorel, Luis Dávila
plot: After a car crash, a female race-car driver is invited by her ex-husband to Majorca, only to discover that he's since remarried, and the rich wife is the one who actually invited her, and she's scheming to get rid of the husband.
